title: IMAP / SMTP Mailbox
description: Connect a private IMAP + SMTP mail server to Conversations — no Gmail or Outlook account required.

operations.name: list_messages
operations.title: List Messages
operations.description: Fetch messages from an IMAP mailbox as standard email objects (from, to, subject, body, attachments). Pass mailbox `sent` to read the configured Sent folder; omit mailbox to read INBOX. Used by the scheduled sync to import mail into conversations.

since.description: Only return messages received on/after this epoch-millisecond timestamp (the sync cursor).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return in one pass (default 25).

mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox/folder to read. Omit for INBOX. Pass `sent` to read the configured Sent folder (connectionConfig.sentMailbox, default Sent).

setupGuide:
Connect any standard mailbox over IMAP (receiving) + SMTP (sending) — no Gmail or Outlook OAuth needed.

1. **Username / Password** — your full email address and its password. If your provider uses 2-factor auth (e.g. Fastmail, Zoho, a self-hosted server with app passwords), generate an **app-specific password** and use that here.
2. **IMAP** — set the IMAP host (e.g. `imap.your-domain.com`). Port `993` with IMAP Secure `true` is implicit TLS (recommended). Port `143` with `false` uses STARTTLS.
3. **SMTP** — set the SMTP host (e.g. `smtp.your-domain.com`). Port `587` with SMTP Secure `false` uses STARTTLS (recommended); port `465` with `true` is implicit TLS.
4. **From Address** — the default/fallback sender. Set it to an address on the domain you send from (e.g. `hello@your-domain.com`).
5. **Use a separate SMTP provider** — leave this off to send through the same mailbox login. Turn it on to relay through a separate provider — e.g. **Resend**: SMTP host `smtp.resend.com`, port `465`/Secure `true`, SMTP username `resend`, SMTP password = your `re_…` API key, and set From Address to a domain you verified in Resend.
6. Click **Test** to verify both IMAP and SMTP, then **Save**. New inbound mail syncs from INBOX and sent mail from your Sent folder into Conversations on a schedule; replies send out over SMTP.

**Split relay + mailbox:** when SMTP goes through a relay (Resend, SendGrid, Amazon SES, …) but IMAP stays on your mail server, Tale **APPENDs a copy of each successful send** to your IMAP Sent folder (default on). That keeps the mailbox archive in sync so scheduled sent sync can rebuild threads. Set **Save sent to IMAP** to `false` only if your relay already writes Sent for you.

**Sent folder name:** most servers use `Sent`; Exchange often uses `Sent Items`. Set **Sent mailbox** in the integration settings if sync misses outbound mail.

**Multiple addresses (support@, billing@, …):** you don't need one integration per address. Route every address into this one mailbox (a catch-all alias, or forwards), and replies automatically go out **from whichever address the customer wrote to** — as long as it's on your send domain (the From Address above is used as the fallback). One mailbox, many addresses.
